authBlocked: Stop the active Homebridge Eufy connection before authenticating, then try again.
authFailed: Authentication failed. Check the account details and try again.
authSummary: This temporary connection stays in the setup window and closes before your account is saved.
authSuccess: Authentication succeeded. Restart Homebridge to start the new account connection.
authTimedOut: Authentication timed out. Start again to create a fresh connection.
dashboardAuthenticationRequiredSummary: The saved account needs authentication before devices can reconnect.
dashboardDegradedSummary: Showing the last complete discovery while the connection recovers.
dashboardDegradedTitle: Devices from the last complete discovery
dashboardIncompleteSummary: Device discovery is incomplete. Existing device information is retained until a complete discovery replaces it.
dashboardMissingSummary: No device snapshot is available yet. Start or restart Homebridge to discover devices.
dashboardOwnerConflictSummary: Another Homebridge Eufy process owns this account connection. Stop the other process before continuing.
dashboardReadySummary: These devices came from the latest complete discovery.
dashboardStaleSummary: The saved device snapshot is no longer current. Restart Homebridge to refresh its status.
diagnosticDescription: This device is recognized, but its primary capabilities do not have a verified HomeKit representation yet.
diagnosticsAuthorized: Diagnostics are authorized for 72 hours. Start the reproduction when you are ready.
diagnosticsComplete: The reproduction interval is complete and the selected evidence is available.
diagnosticsExpired: Diagnostics authorization expired. Start a new session to collect more evidence.
diagnosticsFailed: The diagnostics request failed. Try again.
diagnosticsInactive: Choose an issue profile to begin. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
diagnosticsMissingEvidence: The reproduction is complete, but this evidence is missing: {evidence}. A partial export remains available.
diagnosticsReproducing: Reproduction in progress. Perform the failing action, then end the interval.
diagnosticsSummary: Select only the evidence needed for the issue, then mark the exact reproduction interval.
firstSetupAcknowledgement: I have created a dedicated guest account and shared my Eufy home and devices with it.
firstSetupIntro: Create a separate Eufy account for Homebridge. From your personal account in the Eufy app, share your home and devices with that guest account.
firstSetupReasonBody: Your personal account stays active in the Eufy app on your phone. A separate account prevents the app and Homebridge from competing for the same session and interrupting either connection.
firstSetupTitle: Use a dedicated Eufy guest account
footnote: Independent and unofficial. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anker Innovations or eufy. "eufy" and "Anker" are trademarks of their respective owners. Use responsibly — rapid or failed logins can trigger captcha or temporary cooldowns.
oneAccountSession: One account session at a time
preferenceSaveFailed: The preference could not be saved. Try again.
snapshotModeCloudDescription: Uses only a stored image without waking the camera.
snapshotModeLiveDescription: Requests a fresh live image each time.
snapshotModeRefreshDescription: Returns the cached image immediately and refreshes it in the background at a limited rate.
sessionDetails: Sign-in, captcha, and verification will run here only after the plugin has stopped its existing Eufy connection. Your sign-in details stay within this setup flow.
shareLink: How to share your Eufy home
legacySummary: These V4 settings were intentionally discarded. They were not migrated or executed.
advancedDeviceHelp: Device-specific representation, audio, and snapshot preferences remain on the back of each device tile.
advancedFfmpegHelp: Leave blank to use the FFmpeg executable bundled with the plugin.
advancedPollingHelp: Use 0 to disable scheduled polling. The default is 10 minutes.
advancedSaveFailed: The advanced setting could not be saved. Try again.
advancedSummary: Change infrequent host-level options. Save the Homebridge configuration when finished.
diagnosticsArchiveUnavailable: No diagnostics file was created. Encrypted archive download is planned separately in issue #1010 and is not available in this build. You can still prepare an issue with this support case.
diagnosticsControlAction: Perform the intended control once, then wait for the device state to settle before ending the interval. The plugin will not repeat the action automatically.
diagnosticsControlBefore: Make sure the physical action is safe to perform and identify the single control whose requested and observed states disagree.
diagnosticsControlSummary: Collects bounded command, observation, and HomeKit-adapter evidence to compare the request with the later authoritative state.
diagnosticsDashboardAction: Repeat the navigation, preference change, or save attempt once, then end the interval.
diagnosticsDashboardBefore: Open the page where the interface problem occurs. Do not enter credentials as part of the reproduction.
diagnosticsDashboardSummary: Collects available plugin evidence and reports whether setup-interface evidence is missing for rendering, navigation, or preference-save problems.
diagnosticsDevicesAction: Wait for one normal device refresh or reopen the affected tile, then end the interval after the incorrect or missing state appears.
diagnosticsDevicesBefore: Note which device tile and capability are missing or incorrect. Device identity is not written into reproduction markers.
diagnosticsDevicesSummary: Collects discovery, capability-admission, and HomeKit representation evidence without reconnecting from the dashboard.
diagnosticsLiveAction: Open the selected livestream, request one snapshot, or try talkback once. End the interval after success or failure is visible.
diagnosticsLiveBefore: Choose one camera and one failing media action. This session collects logs only; it does not record or include raw video or talkback audio.
diagnosticsLiveSummary: Collects device-connection and plugin evidence, then reports whether expected FFmpeg evidence is missing for one bounded media reproduction.
diagnosticsOtherAction: Reproduce the problem once, note the exact visible result, and end the interval promptly.
diagnosticsOtherBefore: Reduce the problem to one action if possible. Avoid entering credentials or unrelated personal information.
diagnosticsOtherSummary: Collects general bounded plugin, device-connection, and HomeKit evidence when no narrower profile fits.
diagnosticsPrivacy: Nothing is uploaded. Credentials, tokens, session stores, keys, and raw media are always excluded.
diagnosticsRecordingAction: Trigger one expected recording event, wait until the recording should be available, then end the interval.
diagnosticsRecordingBefore: Confirm HomeKit Secure Video is enabled and note the approximate event time. No raw recording is added to diagnostics.
diagnosticsRecordingSummary: Collects plugin and device-connection evidence, then reports whether expected FFmpeg evidence is missing around one recording attempt.
diagnosticsStartupAction: Restart Homebridge or repeat the failed sign-in transition, return to this panel, then end the interval once the failure or recovery appears.
diagnosticsStartupBefore: The 72-hour authorization survives restart. Start the interval before restarting; never paste a password, captcha answer, or verification code into an issue.
diagnosticsStartupSummary: Collects bounded plugin and device-connection lifecycle evidence for startup, ownership, connection, or authentication-state failures.
advancedPollingInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes greater than or equal to zero.
diagnosticsArchivePlan: Track encrypted archive export in issue #1010
diagnosticsProfileChanged: Start a new diagnostics session to use this profile.
